decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( Drawing Numbers EX-000, EX-001, EX-002, EX-003, EX-004, EX-005, EX-010, EX-011, EX-012, EX-013, Photo Montage, Design and Access Statement, PR-102, PR-103, PR-104, PR-105, PR-110, PR-111, PR-112, PR-113 received  26/03/12 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted- specifically the double glazing, render and balustrade- have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details
description: Refurbish of existing kitchen, opening between two windows to fit a new concertina doors. Make existing terrace usable adding new timber rail and balustrade to match existing at next door
